name: lgo-rv-underwrite
description: RV Park Quick Underwrite — LGO REI's first-pass deal screen for RV parks, MHPs, and campgrounds. Collects the quick-screen inputs, runs the math with a bundled calculator, scores the LGO Decision Matrix, and outputs a one-page Deal Snapshot with a PURSUE / PURSUE ON TERMS / GET MORE INFO / PASS verdict.
